svg.title: BC Parks scene — reference-fit editable vector
svg.desc: Independent reference-fit reconstruction of the inner scene. Colour regions of the surviving aligned flat preview were converted to smoothed cubic Bezier contours and separated into named layers. Not recovered original or previous SVG geometry. All artwork is SVG path geometry, with no embedded raster images or fonts. Outer badge and lettering are intentionally excluded. The package also includes an independently authored redraw with separate editable tree groups.
